entity: US counties flooded with opioid pills 2006-12: overdose death rate, with the lead's window 2019-24
what_we_add: the persistence into the fentanyl era: 40.8 vs 20.2 per 100k in 2019-24 (2.0x) across 1,832 counties; Knox County #27 at 74.5; Food City #674 took 31% of Knox's 30mg+ oxycodone
why: The Washington Post reported the same finding in the same direction - pill-flooded counties had far higher opioid death rates - which matches the lead's 'already dying faster' claim. Its window ends in the pill era; the 2019-24 2x persistence number is ours alone. TN AG's 44% Oxy-30 figure for Food City #674 uses a different denominator, not a contradiction.
